author: Fourdetrance
quote: It’s embarrassing to call this gta. It’s nowhere near what the franchise used to be. If this is where gaming is going, I’m done. It’s terrible and you should avoid it all cost.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: What happened silent hill? F was horrible and this game is just plain boring. Let’s all hope the next release is something quality.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Not sure what happened with this one, but it’s really bad. The handholding is the worst I’ve ever seen, the story isn’t good, the gameplay is decent at best, it’s uninspiring, and it doesn’t represent Wolverine at all. A total pos game. Avoid at all costs.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Playing on a ps5. Terrible story, very repetitive, extremely basic abilities, and the controls are wonky. Whoever gave this a high score is either payed to do so, or works for the company. I don’t see how anyone could truly like this trash.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Another disappointment from Bethesda. What happened to the good games they used to make? Save your money and spend it on something that’s worth your time to play. The newer Bethesda is 100% garbage. Crap story, empty worlds, loading screens galore, crap combat, and the characters are bland. Hard pass on this one.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: My favorite FC game. Great graphics (besides a few graphics glitches here and there), great story, great music (Hammock), awesome vibe- the world really feels alive, lots to do, the challenges and perk point make me want to keep playing, the ai doesn’t play around, and it doesn’t get too repetitive. Some of the controls can be a bit off, but not game breaking in the least- just sometimes annoying. Overall it’s a great game that I don’t mind dropping many hours into. Highly recommended.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I had such high hopes, but the game is a serious letdown- bland writing, boring worlds (they look nice though), the story is meh, doodoo politics, and I just found the entire vibe really crappy. Couldn’t finish the game. Avoid at all costs. The first games was pretty good and the second one failed.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: knowing what we all know now, how can you still make a bad game?! Mostly decent and the rest is just plain bad: the story, the graphics, the lifeless world, lame leveling and the npcs. Avoid if you can, there’s so much more out there that’s truly worth your time to play- and this one isn’t it. Do better.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I absolutely love it! They did a great job and this is what a remaster should be. It retains the character of the original and it’s also very beautiful to look at. All the quirk has been maintained with a nice frame rate, low loading times, and the most important aspect: it still feels like the original- which is what we want. There are a few glitches and it seems that they added a bit of diversity, but I’ll let it pass. Good job Bethesda… just keep politics out of your stuff and I’ll keep paying for your games.
game_title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Why would they release such a low quality game, and I’m talking about the story and characters? Anyone can produce decent graphics, but the story is terrible.I thought ubisoft hit rock bottom two games ago, but here we are with another record low. It’s entertaining to watch them miss the mark with every release. Oof.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Horrible characters, bland story, the hero shooter genre has been beaten to death, and of course: they’re pushing THE MESSAGE- again. The game flopped and rightly so. Stop pushing the message and make something of quality and maybe we’ll start spending money again. Hard pass, do not recommend.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Feels good to know that there are still games worth playing in these times weird agendas in gaming. This game has it all: great music, great story, great graphics, and the characters and boss fights are interesting and epic. The leveling up system is great. One thing I have a gripe about is the invisible walls, they’re too many. Other than that- highly recommended. Bravo!

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I’ve been playing games for many, many years- and this has to be the worst I’ve ever played. Absolute garbage. Everything about this game is wrong. This gameis Ana example of what NOT to do in a game. Oof. The failure of this game has to sting a lot.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: A huge NOPE. Why can’t developers create games within the past few years without throwing politics into their games? While they’re checking off their diversity boxes, I’m not playing their games. Stop the nonsense and get back to good gaming.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Why so much s3xual stuff in the game?! Please stop with the nasty stuff, especially same s3x. Other than that, many layers to maintain interest. Great soundtrack, great story, and lots of stuff to do. My gripes are: the graphics are a little dated for a fairly recent release and the controls are a tad wonky, also how many females actually fought as soldiers and warriors in 431 BC? I’d say close to **** intro has a word on the developers coming from many “s3xual orientations” WHO. CARES. Keep that crap out of games or I’ll keep my money from those particular games.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Overhyped junk. They’re trying too hard to virtue signal and forgot to make the game fun and a memorable experience. They should focus on gaming and not politics.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Been playing games since the Atari and the first NES came out- I have to say that this iteration of the Mario franchise is breath of fresh air! We get new techniques, physics, power ups, new enemies, graphics, music, and we love it. Definitely worth it!

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I’ve been playing video games since the early 80s and it’s rare that a game impresses me this much right off the bat. HL has done that and more: top-notch story, next-gen graphics, pro dialogue, music worthy of a John Williams nod, great controls, leveling up, gameplay options,… the game is basically perfect. I highly recommended if you’re into adventure of the wizard of kind!

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Terrible game, requires an internet connection to play and microtransactions, why? If I have a game, I should be able to play sans connection. It’s a privacy thing for me. Terrible game, avoid at all costs.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Bunch of perverts. I didn’t make it past the first two characters talking about “selling animal p0rn to kids”… in the beginning of the game. Who the f&$k is into this stuff?! If you’re into this game, you’re a nasty pervert that needs some serious help. Seek out a psych quick. I deleted the game immediately.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: HOLY SH$T! I’m an old-school gamer form the 80s, so I’ve had some experience with many, many  games. With that said, this is what games are supposed to be like. It’s a true masterpiece: the story, graphics, sound, music, controls, gameplay, character development, voice actors, and everything else- this is how it should be done. **** Punch, job well done! I’m a devout fan now. This is *THE BEST* game I’ve ever played. Seriously, it takes the #1 spot in my book. Damn good game.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Horrible game. Again, AVOID IT AT ALL COST. It’s cool for about 3 minutes. The novelty wears off almost immediately. The mechanics are decent, but lacking and could be so much better. Hard pass.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: Cash grab alert. They made a REALLY short game, then sold DLC to extend the game. The DLC should’ve been part of the original game. VOTE WITH YOUR MONEY. Don’t encourage this type of bullsheet or it’ll keep happening.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I give this game a 1 because it charges a ton of microtransactions to really do anything. VOTE WITH YOUR MONEY. Stop these companies from making cash-grab games. Don’t pay for this crap.

author: Fourdetrance
quote: I will no longer spend money nor support this franchise until they change everything back to the original. What a piece of crap game. Straight garbage.
